# Week 13 build notes: Capstone, week 4 (report, Executive Summary, outbrief)

Light week. Scenario: Northgate Supply Co. (materials/week9/). Staging plan: `docs/build/week13.js`.

## Files
- `course-w13-lessons.js`: talks 13.1, 13.2, 13.3 (611-781 words each, 4-5 check questions, 1 diagram and 1 real-world callout each) + `COURSE_QUIZ.w13` (20 questions, correct answers spread 5/5/5/5).
- `course-w13-labs.js`: Lab 13.1 Number check and Q&A prep (2 auto-checked choice checkpoints, 6 instructor-read), Lab 13.2 Outbrief reflection (1 auto-checked, 5 instructor-read).
- `course-w13-practice.js`: `deliverables-w13` (sort, 16 items: which document each piece of content belongs in), `acro-w13` (flash, 20 acronyms, all from the Student Platform drill list).
- `course-w13-figures.js`: `w13-pyramid`, `w13-deck-flow`, `w13-challenge`. Generated by a scratch script (gen_w13_figs.js in the session scratchpad, Week 1 palette and helpers). It was not added under docs/tools because this build was limited to the files listed in the task; copy it there if you want the diagrams rebuildable.
- `course-w13-mock.js`: `MOCK_W13` (brief, submit path, key of what a complete pack contains, 5 rubricNotes). No model scores: the model pack stays outside the public repo.
- `docs/build/week13.js`, this file.

## Days (minutes from `node docs/tools/estimate_time.js 13`)
Day 1, Write for leaders and build the deck: talk 13.1 (10), practice deliverables-w13 (10), CSA report part 2 (60), Executive Summary (55), partner review (20), talk 13.2 (10), briefing deck (80), daily survey (3). **248 min.**
Day 2, Rehearse, deliver the outbrief, and submit: talk 13.3 (10), Lab 13.1 (15), rehearse with a partner (45), submit the final pack (10, due before the outbrief), live outbrief (120), Lab 13.2 (10), Week 13 quiz (15), weekly check-in (5). **230 min.**
Every mock block has a `basis`. The outbrief basis assumes a session of 6-7 presenters x (12 min + 6 min questions). A bigger cohort needs two rooms or a longer session; Day 2 then grows past 265.

## Submission paths (no new Firebase paths)
- Final pack: Student Platform Week 10 Submit tab (`MCCoE_Student_Platform.html?week=10`), deliverable link in `mccoe_progress`. This is the legacy week 10 path.
- Labs 13.1 and 13.2: `mccoe_course/{key}/labs/13.1|13.2` via Lab.html.
- Week mock object: `{ id:'w13', title:'Assessment Report and Outbrief', href:'MCCoE_Student_Platform.html?week=10' }` with a 5-criterion rubric (Executive Summary, CSA report, Consistency of numbers, Briefing deck, Live outbrief).

- Legacy week 10 lesson 4 (Outbrief): talk 13.2 (deck: 8-12 slides, order, headline first, 10-15 minutes, explain each number) and talk 13.3 (defending scores, new evidence, not knowing, no blame). Key terms outbrief, briefing deck, defending a score, stakeholder are all defined.
- Legacy week 10 quiz q19-q30 (12 questions: audience, length, contents, CSA, workbook, mismatched numbers, outbrief, challenge, not knowing, new document, opening, "IT guy patched") were rewritten into the Week 13 quiz, plus 8 new questions (comparison, right-sized steps, scope note, slide count, paragraphs on slides, decision slide, describing practices not people, job interview).
- Legacy week 10 labs: step 3 (Executive Summary and CSA), step 4 (deck), step 5 (rehearse, deliver), step 6 (reflect) are Day 1 and Day 2 blocks and Labs 13.1/13.2. Steps 1-2 (risk register, POA&M) are Week 12.
- Legacy week 10 deliverable and its `staffConfirms` note are in MOCK_W13 and the submit block.
- Legacy week 10 resources: Rapid7 board video and Messer audits video are `anytime` items. The other week 10 resources belong to Week 12.
- Hub `week-tasks.js` week 10 items ("Assessment report and executive summary", "Present findings at the outbrief") are covered by blocks b3-b7 on Day 1 and b4-b5 on Day 2.

Dropped: nothing from the Week 13 share of the legacy material.

## New facts
- Northgate: none added. Talk examples use only facts from the materials (for example EV-16 and SCAN-03 both show workstations behind on updates).
- Practice-only examples, clearly labeled as not Northgate: "48.2% vs 48%" rounding case (Lab 13.1 c1) and a visitor-book example answer (Lab 13.1 step 5).
- Real-world callouts: Target CEO resigned 2014 and Equifax CEO retired 2017 (13.1); Colonial Pipeline CEO's Senate testimony that entry was via a VPN account without MFA (13.2); Equifax former CEO's October 2017 testimony blaming one employee, versus GAO-18-559's process findings (13.3).

## Shared-file changes needed
1. `MCCoE_Student_Platform.html` `submitWeek()`: it will not submit Week 10 until the legacy Week 10 quiz is taken and a reflection is written. The quiz now lives at `Quiz.html?w=13`. Please skip the quiz check for weeks 9-10, or accept the course quiz. Until then, the submit block tells students to take that page's quiz if the button asks.
2. `course-data.js`: replace the week 13 entry (currently `legacy: 10`) with this staging plan when approved.
3. Tracker: a grading view for `w13` that shows the `mccoe_progress` week 10 deliverable link, Labs 13.1/13.2 from `mccoe_course`, and the rubric/rubricNotes in `course-w13-mock.js`, plus a way to mark the outbrief delivered (the legacy `staffConfirms` has no tracker field yet).
4. Optional: a `client` or `northgate` callout kind in `Lesson.html` (talks use `kind:'tip'` titled "At Northgate").
5. `docs/tools/estimate_time.js`: `practice()` checks `p.mode === 'flash'`, but sets use `kind:'flash'`, so flash sets are timed at the sort rate (36 s per card instead of 15 s). acro-w13 is in `anytime` only, so this week's day totals are not affected.

## Problems
- Day 2 is exactly 230 minutes and depends on cohort size (see the outbrief basis).
- Labs 13.1/13.2 are timed by the estimator at 15 and 10 minutes; writing three challenge answers will likely take longer than 1 minute per checkpoint. Compare with real class time.
